_: Single source of every value the Steamworks Chrome session enters (s1_17). tools/steam_handoff.py renders the 'When Tom's Steamworks account is ready' section of docs/STEAM.md from this file and checks it (--check in check.sh). Edit here, never in docs/STEAM.md between the steam-handoff markers.

app.store_name: Dreams (working title; Tom picks the final title from docs/steam-store/ name check)
app.developer: WAITING ON TOM: studio name (no family names, no personal identity)
app.publisher: WAITING ON TOM: same as developer unless he picks another

linux_runtime: Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) once the Linux CI boot test passes in the sniper container; otherwise leave 'none' and note it

branches.default: set live by hand in Steamworks only, never by CI

cloud.note: Paths are Godot's default user:// for config/name 'Dreams' (no custom user dir). If config/name ever changes before release, pin application/config/use_custom_user_dir first (s1_17-03) and re-render these rows. P2's docs/steam/backends.md has the measured save sizes.

store.Supported features: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Steam Cloud; Family Sharing; Full controller support only after the Deck checklist row 'full controller play' passes; Online Co-op only after the Steam transport ships

builder.group: Builders (this app only; never 'Everyone'; never Manage Pricing & Discounts or financial rights)
secrets: STEAM_SECRET_WRITER (fine-grained PAT: this repo only, Environments read and write, 90 days)
STEAM_CONFIG_VDF (written by the steam-login workflow, never by hand)

kit.app_icon_184.jpg: Community/Client assets: App icon (184x184 JPG, flattened on the game's dark background)
kit.achievements/: Stats & Achievements > Bulk import (CSV + 256x256 icons, from P2's data/achievements.json)
kit.rich_presence_english.vdf: Community > Rich Presence localization (from P2's data/rich_presence.json)
kit.capsules/: Store page graphical assets (P6 renders, exact sizes)
